WORKED EXAMPLE   Worked example: Orontes's commercial paper
Setting. Suppose Orontes has commercial paper of $3,000,000 due March 31, 2027, and intends to refinance it. Its 2026 statements are issued on March 1, 2027.
Scenario A. Bonds issued on February 10 replace the paper: the whole $3,000,000 is noncurrent.
Scenario C. Shares issued for $2,400,000: that amount is noncurrent and $600,000 stays current. Nothing moves to equity.
Scenario D. A qualifying agreement for 80% of inventory of at least $3,125,000: $2,500,000 noncurrent, $500,000 current.
Check. Figure F12-05 shows all five scenarios, including the two where the whole amount stays current.
Suppose: Orontes, commercial paper of 3,000,000 due March 31, 2027; statements issued March 1, 2027
A. Issues 5-year bonds on February 10 and uses the cash to repay the paper at maturity
B. Repays the paper with cash on January 15, then issues bonds on February 10
C. Issues shares on February 10 for 2,400,000 to repay the paper
D. Signs a qualifying agreement on February 1 to borrow 80% of inventory; inventory will not fall below 3,125,000
E. Same as D, but the lender may cancel if it sees a 'material adverse change'

EXAM TRAP   Refinancing traps
Repaid first, refinanced later: still current.
Refinanced with shares: noncurrent liability up to the proceeds, not equity.
A 'material adverse change' clause makes the agreement fail.

● IFRS CONTRAST   The IAS 1 amendments of 2024
The IAS 1 amendments on classification and covenants apply from January 1, 2024, and are testable now as IFRS contrasts. They confirm that management's intention to refinance does not matter; only rights at the reporting date do.

EXAM TRAP   Warranty traps
Standard warranty: accrue the cost at the sale; do not defer revenue.
Extended plan sold separately: defer revenue; do not accrue a cost.
Expense warranty costs in the year of the sale, not when repairs are paid.

FALSE-FRIEND ALERT   مخصص, محتمل, provision
Arabic مخصص can mean a U.S. allowance, a liability or an IFRS provision; use warranty liability here. محتمل can translate both probable (accrue) and contingent or possible (disclose). French provision pour garantie is the IFRS term; never call a U.S. liability a reserve.
